runners.spotlight: Improver who has finished runner-up in his last three starts and he looked a bit stretched over 7f at Kempton 12 days ago; still unexposed after only four starts and he sets a clear standard on this drop back in trip; hard to beat back on Tapeta.

runners.comment: 4-1 on recent Southwell debut (6f), but he missed the break before finishing last of 12
runners.name: Y Y Star
runners.spotlight: 4-1 on recent Southwell debut (6f, Tapeta) but he missed the break before trailing home in a remote last of 12; should know more this time but this is a tough assignment and he's probably one for later on.

18:00.race_name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap

runners.comment: Won classified stakes two runs back; lesser run when upped in grade over C&D last week
runners.name: Forest Gunner
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f classifed stakes at Lingfield last month, but fared less well upped in grade over C&D last week.

runners.comment: 1-15 on AW; some fair efforts since reverting to AW in November; chance
runners.name: Some Nightmare
runners.owner: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould & Partner
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner, although only one of them on AW (6f, here); some fair runs since reverting to the AW in November, notably when fourth over C&D last week; not ideally drawn but a chance.

runners.comment: Only win was at Newcastle in March; some fair runs since, including three last month
runners.name: What What What
runners.spotlight: Only win came at Newcastle in March when wearing visor for the first time; some fair runs since, including three last month; first run here; could go well.

runners.comment: Off the mark in a 5f classified stakes at Newcastle last time; has a stiffer task here
runners.name: Wee Mary
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark in a 5f classified stakes at Newcastle last time, but has a stiffer task here.

runners.comment: Won C&D h'cap in August; back to winning ways in classified stakes last time; a possible
runners.name: Flickas Girl
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap over C&D in August and got back to winning ways in a classified stakes at Chelmsford last time; could go well again.

runners.comment: Last three runs have been over C&D, latest in June; runner-up on last 5 starts; poor draw
runners.name: Colors Of Freedom
runners.spotlight: Last three wins have all been over C&D, latest in June; runner-up on last five starts, four of them over C&D; not ideally drawn but not out of it.

runners.comment: 0-21; not his best after a break last time but two fair runs before that; each-way chance
runners.name: Kipp Kelly
runners.spotlight: 21-race maiden; wasn't at his best after a break last time, but had been runner-up in a couple of classified races prior to that; each-way chance.

runners.comment: Two wins here; not been in top form recently; has dropped to a good mark and could go well
runners.name: My Genghis
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been here (5f/6f); not been in top form recently but has dropped to a good mark so could go well.

runners.comment: Won four-runner h'cap over C&D in March; bit below par last three runs; others appeal more
runners.name: Kento
runners.spotlight: Only win so far was in a four-runner handicap over C&D in March; bit below par last three runs; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Seven-time AW winner who went close at Southwell last time; respected off just 1lb higher
runners.name: Ernies Valentine
runners.spotlight: Seven-time AW winner, who scored under Phoebe Edwards over C&D in November and he bounced back with a close second at Southwell (1m) 16 days ago; only 1lb higher here and he's respected back at this track.

runners.comment: Has won here on last three starts and he beat a clear second last time; big player again
runners.name: Latin
runners.spotlight: Has record of 31222314111 since September and those last three wins have been at this track; 4lb higher than for his last-gasp success over C&D last time, but he pulled clear with the runner-up and that was another personal best; key player.

runners.comment: Runner-up in hat-trick bid here (9.4f) last time and he's respected back in trip
runners.name: Francesi
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-7 for Tony Carroll when completing a double at Lingfield (1m) last month and he ran another good race when runner-up from a wide draw here last time; has stall nine to deal with again, but he still looks feasibly treated and is respected back in trip.

runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo but was well held on handicap debut at Newcastle last month; down the list
runners.name: Mao Shang Wong
runners.spotlight: Found improvement when runner-up in a Newcastle maiden (1m) in December but he was only eighth of 11 on handicap debut there last month; still unexposed but this is competitive and he needs to kick on again.

runners.comment: Clearcut winner here in December but he's been disappointing in both subsequent runs
runners.name: First Greyed
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner with first four on turf and latest four on Tapeta; his last success was by 3l here (9.4f) in December but he's been disappointing in both subsequent runs and needs to bounce back near his best.

runners.comment: Has won two of his last four including over 9.4f here last time; respected up 3lb
runners.name: Mr Nugget
runners.spotlight: Has won three times on Tapeta since November, including with a narrow success here (9.4f) ten days ago; up 3lb but he was as good as ever last time and this tough 5yo should be in the thick things again.

runners.comment: Two wins here in the autumn but he's hard to predict and comes with risks attached
runners.name: Youarenotforgiven
runners.spotlight: Won twice here (9.4f) in the autumn but he's not easy to predict and has form figures of 5039 in his last four starts; on workable mark but that last run was an 8l defeat and he comes with risks attached; stablemate of Francesi.

runners.comment: 5yo mare who is 1-10 and was down the field over C&D last time; others preferred
runners.name: Toralou
runners.spotlight: 5yo mare who won a Musselburgh maiden (1m, good) last summer; back from short break with close third in a C&D handicap in November but she wasn't in the same form on her return visit the following month; bit to prove again after that and she's now 1-10.

runners.comment: Course winner who was placed over 7f here last time; each-way claims again back up in trip
runners.name: Lessay
runners.spotlight: Ordinary strike-rate of 3-36 but he scored here (7f) in December and was a creditable third back at this track last Monday; should be fine on this step back up in trip and has each-way claims again.

runners.comment: Reached the frame with eyeshields added at Southwell and has claims if he can back that up
runners.name: Beaming Light
runners.owner: R G Robinson & R D Robinson
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row over 1m last June and the first leg was on AW; up and down since his last success but he reached the frame with eyeshields added at Southwell (1m) 16 days ago; has possibilities if he can back that up and he's not ruled out.

runners.comment: Nine-race maiden who has finished down the field in his six handicaps; opposable
runners.name: Implied Volatility
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has finished down the field in six handicaps, including a heavy defeat behind Latin on C&D reappearance last month; now 13lb lower than for his opening mark but he has a lot to prove.

runners.comment: Sole win was in August 2024 and he's struggled in last seven starts; passed over
runners.name: Mooretown Lad
runners.spotlight: Won on turf in Ireland (1m1f, good) in August 2024 but he's struggled over hurdles and on the Flat in his last seven starts; had some traffic issues over C&D last month but he's now 1-15 and others are more convincing.

runners.comment: Last win was over C&D and was an eyecatching third back here last month; respected
runners.name: Stipulation
runners.owner: Horn And Trumpet Lads & S & A Mares
runners.spotlight: Reliable type who completed a double when scoring over C&D in September and was an eyecatching third behind Magic Runner here (9.4f) last month; should get a decent tow into this race and has claims if he gets the breaks.

runners.comment: Just one win from 13 starts and was tailed off at Southwell latest; first-time blinkers
runners.name: Spec Of Light
runners.owner: R G Robinson & R D Robinson
runners.spotlight: Won Southwell handicap (1m, Tapeta) last March but he's been generally disappointing since and was tailed off at Southwell 16 days ago; on dangerous mark on this drop back in trip but he's now 1-13 and others are more convincing; first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces.

runners.comment: 0-14 but he's on a reduced mark and was a clear second here last month; each-way claims
runners.name: Corundum
runners.owner: Mr And Mrs A E Pakenham
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden but he's on a reduced mark and was a clear second here (8.6f) last month; should be fine on this step back up in trip and has each-way claims again.

runners.comment: Two wins over C&D this winter and was a close third here last time; respected up 2lb
runners.name: Magic Runner
runners.spotlight: Two wins over C&D this winter and she ran another good race when a close third here (9.4f) ten days ago; 2lb rise has now kicked in but she was short of room at a crucial stage last time and still looks feasibly treated; big player.

runners.comment: Veteran who has not won on AW since 2023 and was well held at Chelmsford last time
runners.name: Poetic Force
runners.spotlight: Veteran who took advantage of a lower turf mark when winning twice at Brighton (7f/1m) last summer; prolific AW winner but he's not scored in this sphere since March 2023 and was well held at Chelmsford 18 days ago; others look stronger.

runners.comment: Losing run is up to 21 but he's had some close calls at Newcastle this winter; in the mix
runners.name: Powerful Response
runners.spotlight: Losing run is up to 21 but he's had some close calls at Newcastle this winter and ran another solid race when fourth of 12 there (1m) last time; should go well back up in trip and he's in the mix.

runners.comment: Has a patchy profile but he didn't get much luck when fourth over C&D latest; dangerous
runners.name: Law Supreme
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he forced a dead-heat over C&D on Boxing Day and didn't get much luck when a close fourth here (9.4f) ten days ago; ties in closely with Magic Runner on that form and he's an interesting contender off unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Triple C&D winner but he's struggled for current yard and needs a major revival
runners.name: Tiger Beetle
runners.spotlight: Triple C&D winner but he's struggled in five runs for current yard and was beaten 18l here (1m4f) last time; mark continues to fall but he needs a major revival back in trip.

runners.comment: C&D winner in October and he's been placed in all four runs since; shortlisted
runners.name: The Dark Baron
runners.spotlight: Won on AW debut over C&D in October and he's been placed in all four runs since, including a close call here on penultimate run; still on a workable mark and both wins have come under Laura Coughlan; shortlisted.

runners.comment: 11-race maiden who has struggled over hurdles this winter; opposable back on the Flat
runners.name: Launceston
runners.owner: S Keable L Cullimore G Tuck
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden who has struggled at massive prices over hurdles in his last three runs; this is more realistic back on the Flat but he has only one piece of solid form in this sphere and others are preferred.

runners.comment: His last win was three years ago and he's finished tailed off here in last two starts
runners.name: Fleurman
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who is very well treated on old form but last win was in February 2023 and he's finished tailed off here (1m6f/2m) in last two runs; has lots to prove after another break.

runners.comment: C&D winner who scored over 1m6f here in December; big player again up 3lb
runners.name: Francesco Baracca
runners.spotlight: Clearcut win over C&D in the autumn and he got back on the scoresheet with a comfortable success here (1m6f) in December; up 3lb but that was a personal best and he's a major player again back up in trip.

runners.comment: Fair fifth here (9.4f) last time and he's not ruled out on this big step back up in trip
runners.name: Market House
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner, with three on the Flat (1m4f) and one over hurdles (2m3f); out of sorts in last three hurdle runs and he returned to the Flat with a respectable fifth here (9.4f; first run after wind surgery) in December; this is a very different test but he had a close call over 2m at Newcastle last spring and he's in the mix; tongue-tie reapplied.

runners.comment: C&D winner last February and has claims if he can revive back on the Flat
runners.name: Easter Icon
runners.spotlight: Tailed off over hurdles in last two starts but he won two in a row on AW early last year and the first leg was over C&D; still looks feasibly treated and and has claims if he can revive back in this sphere.

runners.comment: Has never won beyond 1m2f and he's been well held in last four starts; opposable
runners.name: Civil Law
runners.spotlight: Five-time course winner, but he's never scored beyond 1m2f and his last success was in November 2023; well handicapped on his old form but he's been well held in last four starts and latest was over 1m6f here last month; opposable.

runners.comment: Dual course winner but he's lost his way and needs a big turnaround
runners.name: Green Team
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner, who scored at Thirsk (1m6f) last summer; now 2lb lower than for that win but he's struggled since and was tailed off here in December; lots to prove and he's never won over this far.

runners.comment: Ran well over hurdles last time and her last Flat win was over 2m on Tapeta; in the mix
runners.name: East End Girl
runners.spotlight: Good third of 15 over hurdles in December, on her second run after a long absence; now switches back to Flat but she's well treated on old form, including a 2m win on Tapeta at Newcastle; one to keep an eye on.

runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo and he's a possible improver upped to 2m on handicap debut
runners.name: Kings Cruiser
runners.spotlight: Struggled at big prices in three qualifying runs (1m3f/1m4f) this winter but he's a half-brother to a 2m Flat winner and is a possible improver now upped in trip on handicap debut; needs watching in market.

runners.breeder: Al Shaqab Racing & S C E A Des Prairies
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner who had an excuse here last time; needs close look after a short break
runners.name: Sneaky Blinder
runners.spotlight: Won twice over C&D in the autumn and he had an excuse in his final run last year (finished lame); returns after another short break but he's only 3lb higher than for his last success and is still unexposed at this trip; dangerous.

runners.spotlight: Finished down the field in all six runs and was behind Frankali when sixth at Lingfield (7f) last month; continues to drop down the weights but he took a strong hold last time and needs improvement with visor added.

runners.comment: Unexposed gelding who's a possible improver up in trip on handicap debut; blinkers on
runners.name: Crimson Rambler
runners.spotlight: Has struggled at big prices in all four runs (5f/6f), but headgear is now added and he's a possible improver upped in trip on handicap debut; needs checking in the market.

runners.comment: Well held in all four runs including on recent handicap debut at Newcastle (7f)
runners.name: Fickle McSelfish
runners.spotlight: Well held in three qualifying runs this winter and same story on handicap debut at Newcastle (7f, Tapeta) 11 days ago; others preferred.

runners.comment: Better effort when runner-up over C&D last month and has claims if he can build on that
runners.name: Electrocution
runners.spotlight: 0-6 but he ran his best race so far when runner-up behind an odds-on rival in a C&D handicap two weeks ago; pulled clear of the third and has possibilities if he can back that up.

runners.comment: Has struggled in his five runs and was beaten 19l in a C&D handicap last time
runners.name: Spirit Of Mara
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
runners.spotlight: Has not finished closer than seventh in five runs since September and was beaten 19l in a C&D handicap (50-1) last month; opposable.

runners.comment: Handicap newcomer and she needs checking in market at this new trip
runners.name: Exhibition Match
runners.spotlight: Didn't show much in her first three runs but there was a hint of promise when fourth in a maiden here (6f) two weeks ago; this is more realistic on handicap debut and she's one to keep an eye on at this new trip; yard also runs Frankali.

runners.comment: Won at Chelmsford in the autumn but she's not hit the same level since and is now 1-10
runners.name: Miss Ayala
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a 7f nursery at Chelmsford in September but she's not hit the same level since and was well held over C&D last time; record is now 1-10 and others are more convincing.

runners.comment: Well-held fifth in both handicaps and needs a transformation back in trip
runners.name: Ezera
runners.owner: D Macauliffe A Don & LDS Bloodstock
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who finished a well-held fifth at big prices in two 1m handicaps last month; still early days but she needs a transformation on this drop back in trip.

runners.comment: Reached the frame in 7f handicaps in last two starts but she needs to find more
runners.name: Blue Mountains
runners.spotlight: Reached the frame in 7f handicaps in her last two runs but she was beaten around 5l over C&D last time; still lightly raced but she needs to find more to make a serious impact.
